title: Closed complementary subtopoi: factorization and supported module sheaves
statement:
Let $\mathcal T$ be a Grothendieck topos (sheaves of sets on a small site in [def-weil-size-convention]), let $U\hookrightarrow1_{\mathcal T}$ be a subterminal object (a monomorphism to the terminal object), and let $j:\mathcal T/U\to\mathcal T$ be its open slice topos. The full subcategory of objects $H$ for which $U\times H\to U$ is an isomorphism is a topos $\mathcal Z$, with a geometric embedding $i:\mathcal Z\to\mathcal T$ whose direct image is this inclusion. This is the closed subtopos complementary to $U$. For every Grothendieck topos $\mathcal E$, composition with $i$ identifies morphisms $\mathcal E\to\mathcal Z$ with morphisms $a:\mathcal E\to\mathcal T$ such that $a^{-1}U$ is initial, including their $2$-morphisms (natural transformations between direct-image functors as in [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]). In particular, the inverse image of this closed subtopos under $a$ is the closed complement of $a^{-1}U$.

Let $\Lambda$ be any commutative ring and use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over the constant ring sheaves of [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Write $i^*$ for inverse image on these modules, with its adjunction $i^*\dashv i_*$. The functor $i_*$ on these modules is exact and fully faithful, its adjunction counit $i^*i_*\to1$ is an isomorphism, and its essential image consists exactly of modules $M$ with $j^*M=0$. Equivalently, for such $M$ the actual adjunction unit $M\to i_*i^*M$ is an isomorphism.

For any closed immersion of schemes $k:F\hookrightarrow S$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], its geometric morphism on small etale topoi [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] identifies $F_{\mathrm{Et}}$ with this closed complement in $S_{\mathrm{Et}}$ for the subterminal sheaf represented by $S\setminus F$.

source.place: Tags 08LY (lemma-closed-subtopos), 08LZ (definition-closed-subtopos), 08M0 (definition-immersion-topoi), 08M1 (lemma-closed-immersion); algebraic-structure extension in Tag 00YV (proposition-functoriality-algebraic-structures-topoi), and module form also in sites-modules.tex Tag 08M3 (lemma-i-star-equivalence). The scheme example is etale-cohomology.tex Tag 04CA (proposition-closed-immersion-pushforward)(1). The factorization characterization is the universal-property form of the closed complement, recorded as an agent formulation of this construction.
